verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions running a headless browser (e.g., Chromium or Playwright), a virtual display, VNC, or a desktop environment inside the sandbox. A 'full Linux environment', shell exec, Docker-in-sandbox, and preview URLs are general building blocks a developer might use to set one up, not a documented capability for this story, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run a headless browser or full desktop environment inside the sandbox
